metadata.question: Was there an active fire present near Paradise, California between November 7, 2018 to November 10, 2018?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about active fires near Paradise, California during November 7-10, 2018. This is the timeframe of the devastating Camp Fire that destroyed Paradise. For fire detection, I should use: 1. MODIS Active Fire data (MCD14ML) or VIIRS Active Fire data 2. Define a geometry around Paradise, California 3. Check for fire detections in that area during the specified dates I'll use MODIS Active Fire data (MODIS/006/MCD14ML) which provides thermal anomalies and fire detection. Steps: 1. Define Paradise, CA location as a point and buffer it to create an area of interest 2. Get MODIS active fire data for the date range 3. Filter by confidence level (high confidence fires) 4. Count the number of fire detections 5. If any fires detected, answer "A: Yes", otherwise "B: No" 6. Handle cases where no data is available (C1) or no valid pixels (C2) The MODIS Active Fire collection provides fire detection with confidence levels. I'll consider high confidence fires as "active fires". ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const paradise = ee.Geometry.Point([-121.6219, 39.7596]); // Paradise, CA coordinates const area = paradise.buffer(20000); // 20km buffer around Paradise const startDate = '2018-11-07'; const endDate = '2018-11-10'; // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Active Fires const fireCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD14ML') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(area); const collectionSize = fireCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Fire detections in collection: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("No fire detection data found for the specified period."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Filter for high confidence fires const highConfidenceFires = fireCollection.filter(ee.Filter.gte('confidence', 80)); const highConfCount = highConfidenceFires.size().getInfo(); console.log(`High confidence fires (>=80%): ${highConfCount}`); // Count total fire pixels in the area const fireCounts = fireCollection.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: area, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const totalFirePixels = fireCounts.get('confidence').getInfo(); console.log(`Total fire pixels in area: ${totalFirePixels}`); if (totalFirePixels === 0) { console.log("No fire pixels detected in the area."); console.log("B"); return; } // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (highConfCount > 0) { console.log(`Active fires detected with high confidence: ${highConfCount}`); console.log("A"); } else if (totalFirePixels > 0) { console.log("Fire pixels detected but below high confidence threshold."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("No fire activity detected."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
